newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market late day report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market late day report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were sharply higher in late session trade after rising with other markets on favourable U.S. inflation news.

News of an U.S. overall consumer price index rise of 0.1 percent in March, and a 0.2 percent rise in the core rate reassured markets nervous after a 0.4 percent rise in the March core producer price index reported last Friday.

Swiss bonds extended recent gains. Prices may rise further if the June Confederate Bond futures contract can hold above resistance at 118.00/118.10. Traders also were watching Bund futures which topped resistance in late trade.
